news.title: High number of new and inexperienced directors

news.title: Classic Filaments Limited Approves Appointment of Prachi as Company Secretary & Compliance Officer, Effective April 23, 2026
news.body: Classic Filaments Limited at its board of directors meeting held on April 23, 2026, approved the appointment of Ms. Prachi as Company Secretary & Compliance Officer of the Company on the recommendation of Nomination & Remuneration Committee, with effect from April 23, 2026. Ms. Prachi is a qualified Company Secretary (CS) with an LL.B. and over 5 years of progressive experience in corporate secretarial, legal, and compliance functions. She has extensive hands-on experience in incorporation of companies and LLPs, drafting board resolutions and agreements, handling ROC and MCA filings, conducting due diligence, and managing secretarial and internal audits. news.title: Sumit Bansal, Vikkas Bansal, Tarun Jain and Varun Jindal  completed the acquisition of 68.52% stake in Classic Filaments Limited (BSE:540310) from Bharat Anand kumar Patel, Amit Anandbhai Patel, Jayanti Madhubhai Gaudani and Ajay Madhubhai Gaudani.
news.body:
Sumit Bansal, Vikkas Bansal, Tarun Jain and Varun Jindal  entered into a share purchase agreement to acquire 68.52% stake in Classic Filaments Limited (BSE:540310) from Bharat Anand kumar Patel, Amit Anandbhai Patel, Jayanti Madhubhai Gaudani and Ajay Madhubhai Gaudani for INR 41.9 million on October 24, 2025. In a related transaction Sumit Bansal, Vikkas Bansal, Tarun Jain and Varun Jindal proposed to acquire 26% stake in Classic Filaments Limited. Upon completion of the transactions, Sumit Bansal, Vikkas Bansal, Tarun Jain and Varun Jindal will jointly hold 94.51% stake in Classic Filaments Limited.
